info.name: Sami Nawari - Stripe & Payments API
info.description: Collection of all Seller Stripe Connect and Buyer Online Payment APIs with sample request bodies, parameters, and responses.

request.description: Creates or retrieves an Express Stripe Connected Account for the authenticated seller and returns the onboarding URL.

response.name: 200 - Onboarding Link Created

response.name: 200 - Connected & Charges Enabled

request.description: Generates a single-sign-on login link for the seller to view their payouts, bank info, and earnings on the Stripe Express Dashboard.

response.name: 200 - Dashboard Login Link Created

request.description: Places an order from the buyer's active cart. If paymentMethod is ONLINE, status is set to PENDING_PAYMENT.
Generates a hosted Stripe Checkout URL for the buyer. Funds are directed to the connected seller account.

item.name: 3. Get Buyer Profile (with Recipes, Meals, Grocery Stats)

request.description: Retrieves the logged-in buyer user profile along with stats (Recipes Saved, Meals Cooked / Completed Orders, Grocery Lists count).
Adds or removes a seller from the buyer's favorites. Accepts either the Seller's User.id or SellerProfile.id as 'sellerId'. Also available at POST /seller/favorites/toggle.

response.name: 200 - Seller Added to Favorites
200 - Seller Removed from Favorites

query.description: Optional: Buyer latitude to calculate distanceKm
Optional: Buyer longitude to calculate distanceKm
